confusions: `los resume` showed the confirmed stage but 'Open here —', 'Evidence none', 'Last result none', although the stage working note records 'Stopped at step 4' and an explicit NEXT line; I had to find the working note separately.

`note-read STAGE_ID` fails ('note not found'); the working-note text is only exposed as notes_text inside `inspect STUDY_MAP_ID` — I discovered that later and read the first stage note straight from disk.

There is no command that lists inbox items or Garden seeds: `inspect inbox` → record not found, `search "" --type inbox` → []. `status` gives counts only; the Nebula view lists Garden seeds; the inbox had to be read with ls/cat.
Generated Markdown views (reading room, nebula, atlas, health) did not exist in the fresh world (only generated/derived-state); `status` points to them and says `make views`.

Metadata `search` does not look at note bodies: 'duplicate', 'too high', 'lottery' found no note although note bodies contain them; `--content` must be added, and multi-word content queries match single tokens (e.g. 'do not' hits nearly every note via its id line).
`related NOTE_ID` returns only the note's own concept/source/workspace links — never another note sharing the concept, the deprecated predecessor, the inbox item or Garden seed on the same topic.
Batch `inspect unit-statlearn-l03 study-map-statlearn-l03` was refused entirely because L03 has no study map (documented behaviour, but the error names only the missing id).
corrective_steps: Ran `make views PYTHON=/tmp/evalenv/bin/python` to build the views referenced by `status`.
Used `inspect study-map-…` to read stage working notes.
Dumped all 116 notes via `note-read` (loop) to answer corpus-wide questions (Q29, Q34–Q36).
consumer.outcome: All 36 questions answered with record-level evidence (answers.jsonl). Single-record questions (grades, dates, stored decisions, one note) were quick via inspect/search/note-read. Corpus-wide questions (which notes were corrected, duplicates, answered Garden seeds, cross-course connections) had no product support and were answered by reading every note.

internal.transaction_behavior: Read-only scenario; no gateway writes. `los operations` listed no operations (reads are not traced there).

internal.derived_changes: `make views` added 137 derived files under generated/ (Markdown views, manifest.json, derived-state blobs; 983,267 bytes). Canonical digest unchanged.

friction.description: `related` does not surface sibling notes, deprecated predecessors or Garden seeds; corpus-level questions (Q29, Q34, Q35, Q36) forced a full read of all 116 notes via a note-read loop (~110 KB).
`resume` claims 'Open here —' and 'Evidence none' for a stage whose working note says exactly where the learner stopped and what is next.
friction.cost: 3 extra tool calls (plan-edit-context, failed note-read, file read)

friction.description: The human views referenced by `status` (reading room, nebula) are not built in a fresh installation; `make views` is required first and uses PYTHON/venv detection from the Makefile.
Default `search` is metadata-only (titles/aliases/ids); body words require `--content`, whose multi-word matching is token-OR with frequent frontmatter `id:` snippets, producing noisy results.
Domain atlas, concept map and health report were read as Markdown to enumerate notes and relations — there is no list-notes command.

scenario_record.product_vs_reading: Product commands located the key record for Q01–Q25, Q30, Q31, Q33 directly; Q27–Q29, Q32, Q34–Q36 relied mainly on agent reading of the complete corpus.

uncertainties: Wall-clock minutes are from the container clock (00:14:55 → 00:27:46 UTC).
